subject: The pattern you missed at 3AM
preview_text: A single screenshot can reveal what your gut has been trying to tell you for weeks. Here's how.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling when you re-read a text at 3AM and something feels off? I've been there. But here's what most people miss: the pattern isn't in one message. It's in the space between them.

I've analyzed over 800 conversations with this app, and the biggest red flag isn't what's said. It's what's repeated. A subtle shift in tone, a sudden deflection, a pattern of blame disguised as concern. These are the threads that weave into a toxic fabric.

Here's the hack: don't just scan one conversation. Scan three from different weeks. The app's pattern detection will light up like a Christmas tree. You'll see the gaslighting emerge, the love bombing fade, the manipulation become a script. It's a superpower.

Open the app, go to your history, and scan your last three arguments. Watch the toxicity score spike in a way you never saw coming. Then you'll know. P.S. Most users who do this say it's the clearest they've ever seen their relationship. Do it now.
